IN THE COURT OF CHANCERY OF THE STATE OF DELAWARE

RIDGELINE MANUFACTURING CORP.,
                Plaintiff,

v.                                    C.A. No. ____

NORTHSTAR ANALYTICS, INC.,
                Defendant.

VERIFIED COMPLAINT FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT
AND FRAUDULENT INDUCEMENT

Plaintiff Ridgeline Manufacturing Corp. ("Ridgeline"), by and through
undersigned counsel, alleges the following:

PARTIES, JURISDICTION, AND VENUE

1. Plaintiff Ridgeline is an Ohio corporation with its principal place of
business in Cleveland, Ohio.

2. Defendant Northstar Analytics, Inc. ("Northstar") is a Delaware
corporation with its principal place of business in San Francisco, California.

3. Jurisdiction and venue are proper under Section 7 of the Master Services
Agreement dated March 3, 2024, which specifies Delaware law and the state or
federal courts located in Wilmington, Delaware.

FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS

4. On March 3, 2024, the parties executed a Master Services Agreement
("MSA"), and on March 15, 2024, Statement of Work No. 1 ("SOW-1"), for
Northstar's deployment of a factory-floor telemetry and analytics platform on
Ridgeline's Lines A and B.

5. Northstar committed to a production-cutover milestone on August 30, 2024,
and a 99.9% monthly uptime service level, based on representations made in
writing in February 2024.

6. Northstar missed the production-cutover milestone, delivered corrupt
telemetry on Line B, and failed to meet the 99.9% uptime commitment in each of
July, August, and September 2024.

7. On October 4, 2024, Ridgeline issued a written notice of material breach
under Section 3 of the MSA, providing Northstar the contractual thirty (30)
day cure period.

8. Northstar failed to cure. Ridgeline terminated the MSA for cause on
November 4, 2024, and engaged a substitute integrator to remediate the
corrupt telemetry pipeline.

COUNT I - BREACH OF CONTRACT (MSA and SOW-1)

9. Ridgeline incorporates the foregoing allegations.

10. Northstar's failure to achieve M3, to meet the 99.9% uptime commitment,
and to complete the Section 1(d) training was a material breach of the MSA
and SOW-1. The breach was not cured within the contractual cure period.
Ridgeline has suffered direct damages including fees paid, remediation costs,
and cover costs to complete the promised platform.

COUNT II - FRAUDULENT INDUCEMENT

11. Ridgeline incorporates the foregoing allegations.

12. Northstar's February 7, 2024 representations regarding uptime, milestone
capability, and training were made with knowledge of, or reckless disregard
for, Northstar's inability to perform. Ridgeline relied on those
representations in executing the MSA and SOW-1 and in scheduling downstream
automotive-customer commitments.

13. The fraud claim is independent of the contractual promise itself and is
therefore not barred by the economic-loss doctrine. Any contractual
limitation-of-liability provision is unenforceable to bar recovery on this
count.

PRAYER FOR RELIEF

WHEREFORE, Ridgeline respectfully requests: (a) direct and consequential
damages on Count I, subject to the MSA's cap on consequentials; (b) full
compensatory damages on Count II, unconstrained by any contractual cap; (c)
pre- and post-judgment interest; (d) attorneys' fees where recoverable; and
(e) such other relief as the Court deems just and proper.

Dated: November 12, 2024.
Respectfully submitted, counsel for Plaintiff Ridgeline Manufacturing Corp.
